title: Unverified: the full Russian walk did not finish (stalled after its tour section); not traced to a cause
detail: test/i18n_walk_cmd.js at 1440 px (RU) on the merged build started at 16:49:55. It reached Sound on (Chrome's audio process started at about 16:55, right after the walk's Shift+M). No result came by 17:06, and the walk normally takes about 7 minutes. The headless renderer sat idle at 0 % CPU while the daemon waited on a CDP call, so this is not a busy loop. I reran the walk's tour section alone on the merged build (RU, 1440, after Sound on, as in the walk): all 9 chapters stepped through in 2 minutes with 0 exceptions. So the stall is in a later section (the Inspector for every card, Parameters, the planes' menu, constructions, or the narrow panels), or in the environment. There was no v16 control run, so I cannot say whether the merge caused it. Other Russian evidence is clean: make_ru_table --strict gives 2289 entries and 0 unresolved, and it reads v161-user5.json (V161_HERE); src/i18n_ru.js regenerates byte for byte; the merger's i18n_cmd passes 94 with 0 fails; my sweep of all 14 examples in Russian found 0 console errors, with titles such as 'рельеф функции Im F, листы k = −2…2' and 'оба листа'.
evidence: notes/v16-user5/review-regress-evidence/runq.log (walk_1440 TIMEOUT); notes/v16-user5/review-regress-evidence/walk_tour.log (tour section alone completes); notes/v16-user5/review-regress-evidence/examples_errs.json (ru rows); notes/v16-user5/review-regress-evidence/cmds/walk_1440.js, cmds/walk_tour.js
fix: Rerun i18n_walk_cmd.js at 1440 with a timestamped log line per section (as in cmds/walk_tour.js), and run v16-candidate/dist as a control in the same session. If only the merged build stalls, find the CDP call it stops on. Do not ship v16.1 without a finished walk ('Russian complete').

title: The tour's All sheets step and the Help still say All sheets draws 'the whole Riemann surface' (log draws k = −2…2)
detail: The merge rewrote the export captions, the Landscape title and the gallery name ('Every sheet of the logarithm' became 'Sheets of the logarithm'). Two older claims of the same kind remain: src/tour.js:274, the 'All sheets' step ('All sheets draws the whole Riemann surface of a multivalued map'), and src/app.js:12657, the Help ('for a map with a branch cut, All sheets draws its whole Riemann surface'). The tour step loads log z, so its callout says 'whole Riemann surface' while the Landscape title under it reads 'landscape of Im F, sheets k = −2…2'. This is exactly what the user objected to. The text is unchanged from v16, so it is not a regression, but it now contradicts the corrected titles and captions. (The tour scene's internal name, src/tour.js:76 'Every sheet of the logarithm', is not shown anywhere.)
evidence: src/tour.js:274, src/app.js:12657, src/tour.js:76; notes/v16-user5/review-regress-evidence/examples_errs.json row ta/en/13 (title 'sheets k = −2…2')
fix: Reword both, for example: tour 'In Landscape, All sheets draws the sheets of a multivalued map instead of its cut principal branch: here Im log z climbs a helicoid around 0, on the sheets k = −2, …, 2.' Help: 'draws its sheets (all of them when there are finitely many, a window k = −2…2 otherwise) instead of the cut principal branch'. Put the Russian in notes/i18n/ru/v161-user5.json and rerun make_ru_table --strict.

title: All sheets while a deformation plays adds 2 to 4 ms GPU per Landscape render. 60 fps holds on the Mac; the Android phone is unmeasured
detail: New work, not a regression of an existing path. v16 drew one surface while deforming, and the merge now redoes the sheets' transform feedback for K surfaces on every new t. I paired ta against v16 under the same load (alternating ta, v16, ta, v16; Landscape; 1440x900 and 390x844 with Android emulation). The cases were the user's sin sqrt z with sqrt bracketed (K = 2) and a heavy chain [cube root, log, erf(z^2)*erf(1/(z+0.3)), sin] deformed whole (K = 15). Every run is 60 fps, and frame p95 is ta 17.5 to 19.4 ms against v16 17.5 to 18.9 ms. With All sheets off, ta equals v16. At rest with All sheets on, ta equals v16 (17.0 to 17.6 against 17.2 to 17.6). The GPU cost itself, as the wall time of two renderLeft calls with a pixel read where the first redoes the transform feedback at a new t, is p50 14.1 to 16.5 ms (ta) against 11.3 to 12.8 ms (v16) and p90 17.4 to 20.1 against 13.9 to 16.6. That is about +3 ms on ANGLE Metal. The 390 px runs only emulate a phone on the Mac's GPU, and the user's Android phone GPU is several times slower.
fix: Before release, measure the user's case and a K = 15 chain playing on the Android phone (Chrome remote debugging, or EXT_disjoint_timer_query_webgl2 in a test page). If it misses 60 fps, profile which pass costs the time (the transform feedback over the K tiles, or the K-surface draw) before choosing a fix. Do not reduce the surface quality. A paused or held t already reuses the cached transform-feedback output (the landS key includes the map).
